title: The Lighthouse That Hummed
sentences: A small lighthouse on a quiet cliff liked to hum at night.
Its tune was soft, and only the sleepy gulls could hear it.
One foggy evening a lost boat drifted near the rocks.
The sailor could not see the shore, but he heard a hum.
He followed the gentle sound through the gray mist.
The lighthouse hummed louder, and its lamp glowed warm.
The boat slipped past the rocks and reached the harbor.
The sailor waved at the tower and whispered thank you.
The lighthouse blinked twice, which was its way of smiling.
From that night on, the gulls hummed along every evening.
